classification.zh: 总部直管外派销售规划；工资为待协商目标，福利与成本为独立预算假设，均非已发生支出或客户订单。
classification.en: HQ-managed assignment plan. Pay is a negotiation target; benefits and costs are separate planning inputs, not incurred expense or customer orders.

reference.zh: Refine历史福利结构：餐补150迪拉姆/天、单人住房、车辆、年假机票；新岗位金额与适用天数另议。
reference.en: Historic Refine structure: AED 150/day meals, single-person housing, vehicle and annual-leave flights; negotiate new-role amounts / eligible days.

rows.en: Entry / status, residence and ID allowance

rows.zh: 工作许可及外籍员工附加费额度
签证、居留及出入境额度

budget_rows.zh: 固定工资谈判目标
AED50,000/月×12；福利和费用另列，尚未达成协议
budget_rows.en: AED 50,000/month ×12; benefits and expenses separate; not agreed

budget_rows.zh: 雇主法定成本预留
暂列工资6%；终止服务金等按适用合同重算，不是统一法定税率
budget_rows.en: 6% of pay as a reserve; recalculate end-of-service / other duties under the contract, not a statutory flat rate

budget_rows.zh: 单人驻地住宿与公用支出
AED7,500/月；公司提供或按上限报销二选一
budget_rows.en: AED 7,500/month; company provision OR capped reimbursement

budget_rows.zh: 车辆与驻地交通
AED2,200/月；公司车辆或交通额度二选一
budget_rows.en: AED 2,200/month; company vehicle OR mobility allowance

budget_rows.zh: 驻外餐补参考额度
参考旧政策AED150/天×365；是否覆盖休假日待议，客户餐不重复报销
budget_rows.en: Historic-policy reference AED 150/day ×365; leave-day eligibility pending; no duplicate meal claims

budget_rows.zh: 通信与工作工具
AED4,400/年，另于工资及交通之外
阿联酋医疗保险
AED6,000/年为个人保单预算，签证体检另列
budget_rows.en: AED 6,000/year planning premium; visa fitness exam separate

budget_rows.zh: 沙特医疗保险
SAR3,000/年保单预算；两国保单衔接据承保范围核定
budget_rows.en: SAR 3,000/year planning premium; coordinate two-country coverage

budget_rows.zh: 总部述职与年假往返机票
两次往返×USD2,000；含1次年假，年假工资已在12薪内
budget_rows.en: Two returns ×USD 2,000, including one leave trip; paid leave already in 12-month salary

budget_rows.zh: 首次外派安置
搬迁与设备USD5,000一次；押金另列现金占用
budget_rows.en: USD 5,000 once for relocation / equipment; refundable deposit separate

budget_rows.zh: 阿联酋工作许可与居留
AED8,000办理、Y2预留1,000、Y3续办8,000；按实际期限替换
budget_rows.en: AED 8,000 issue, Y2 allowance 1,000, Y3 renew 8,000; replace with actual validity

budget_rows.zh: 沙特工作签证与许可
SAR20,000首办、续年15,000；按一般雇主路径预留，须有合规承办主体
budget_rows.en: SAR 20,000 initial /15,000 annual renewal; general employer-route reserve requires a lawful sponsor

budget_rows.zh: 海湾客户差旅
Y1六次×USD2,000；机票、酒店、接驳，餐补不重复
budget_rows.en: Y1 six ×USD 2,000: flights / hotels / transfers; meals not duplicated

budget_rows.zh: 客户工作会与阿语支持
Y1每月USD500；围绕具名客户议题
小型行业交流与演示
Y1两场×USD3,000；以客户开发为用途
客户材料与演示样例
Y1五个工作包×USD1,000
用工、税务与合同顾问
按次采购；两国工作安排、PE与商务条款
budget_rows.en: Case-based advice on two-country work, PE and commercial terms

budget_rows.zh: PRO按件办理服务
USD2,000/年仅为专业服务费；官方规费另列
budget_rows.en: USD 2,000/year service fee only; official charges separate

budget_rows.zh: 两国合规雇佣服务预留
阿联酋USD8,000+沙特USD6,000/年；不含工资、保险、签证规费；以获批路径报价替换
budget_rows.en: UAE USD 8,000 + Saudi USD 6,000/year; excludes wages, insurance and permits; replace with approved-route quote

budget_rows.zh: 总部非计费售前
Y1十二个有效人周×USD3,000；付费交付另计
budget_rows.en: Y1 twelve effective person-weeks ×USD 3,000; paid delivery separate

scope.zh: 一个业务问题、流程与数据基线、下一阶段SOW；约2个有效周，客户日历4-8周。
scope.en: One problem, workflow / data baseline and next-stage SOW; about two active weeks across 4-8 calendar weeks.

scope.zh: 一种凭证、两类参与方、最多3个接口和一个测试流程；约6个技术周，客户日历8-16周。
scope.en: One credential, two roles, up to three interfaces and one test workflow; about six technical weeks across 8-16 calendar weeks.

scope.zh: 一个运营主体、一个流程、最多3个既有系统接口；24人周，客户日历基线4个月。
scope.en: One operator, one workflow and up to three existing-system interfaces; 24 person-weeks over a four-month baseline.

scope.zh: 每个上线项目每月1个人日支持USD700，加云与监测USD200；额外服务另报。
scope.en: Per live project: one support person-day USD 700 + cloud / monitoring USD 200 per month; extra work priced separately.

assumptions.zh: 住房按季度预拨、医疗保单按年支付，工资及其他福利按月预算。雇主法定权益预留按月计入资金安排，实际支出据适用制度替换。
assumptions.en: Budget housing quarterly, medical policies annually and pay / other benefits monthly. Employer statutory reserves are funded monthly; replace with actual applicable payment rules.

assumptions.zh: 年薪AED600,000按12个月固定工资目标测算，未包含住宿、车辆、餐补、差旅、签证及雇主成本；薪酬拆分、税负和激励均待协商。三年不预设自动加薪。
assumptions.en: AED 600,000 is modelled as 12-month fixed-pay target, excluding housing, vehicle, meals, travel, visas and employer costs. Pay split, tax and incentive terms remain open; no automatic raises.

assumptions.zh: Refine旧政策仅作为福利结构参考。AED150/天暂按365天；每减少30个计补日，年度成本减少AED4,500。带薪年假已包含12薪，不额外增加一个月工资。
assumptions.en: Refine is only a benefit-structure reference. AED 150/day is budgeted over 365 days; 30 fewer eligible days saves AED 4,500/year. Paid leave is inside 12 salaries, not a 13th payment.

assumptions.zh: 两国签证预算为公司承担的办理额度，不是获批证明或官方套餐。实际由合法雇主/担保主体办理；不默认两份居留或工作许可可以同时成立。
assumptions.en: Two-country visa amounts are employer-funded allowances, not approvals or official packages. A lawful employer / sponsor arranges permission; concurrent residence / work rights are not presumed.

assumptions.zh: 保险、体检、政府规费、PRO和雇佣服务费分开；同一事项不重复计费。获批替代路径应替换对应额度。
assumptions.en: Separate insurance, medical exams, official fees, PRO and employment-service charges. Avoid duplicates and replace the relevant allowance when an alternative route is approved.

assumptions.zh: AED/USD3.6725、SAR/USD3.75为预算折算基准；支付时按银行汇率及手续费结算，美元展示取整、模型保留精度。
assumptions.en: Budget FX: AED 3.6725 and SAR 3.75 per USD. Settle at bank rates / fees; display rounded USD while retaining model precision.

assumptions.zh: 薪酬提高不自动提高客户购买力。保留原组合为基准，增长情景另增加生产订单及持续服务，并披露总部交付资源。
assumptions.en: Higher pay does not increase client demand. Retain the original base mix; a separate growth case adds production orders / support with explicit HQ delivery capacity.

assumptions.zh: 毛利激励5%仅为额外预算敏感性，未视为双方同意；若年包已含浮动部分，重新拆分，避免重复计薪。贡献同时可还原为无激励口径。
assumptions.en: A5% paid-margin incentive is a separate, unagreed sensitivity. If the package includes variable pay, split it to avoid duplication. Contribution can also be read before incentives.

assumptions.zh: 收入在计划验收时列入，直接成本实施期费用化，支持按月列入；管理模型并非审计会计报表。实际按合同及会计准则确认。
assumptions.en: Plan revenue at acceptance, expense delivery during implementation and recognize support monthly. This management model is not audited financial reporting; actual accounting follows contracts / standards.

assumptions.zh: 年度固定配置、项目直接成本和激励共同形成总支出；15%年度预留与峰值缺口15%缓冲属于不同视角，不重复相加。押金USD2,000仅为现金占用。
assumptions.en: Annual fixed resources, direct projects and incentives form total spend. Annual 15% reserve and 15% liquidity buffer are different views, not additive. USD 2,000 refundable deposit is cash use only.

assumptions.zh: 采用新聘岗位全成本口径，不扣除未经确认的既有总部工资预算。贡献未含总部全部管理分摊、所得税、VAT及法定追加成本。
assumptions.en: Use full new-hire cost without deducting unconfirmed existing HQ payroll. Contribution excludes unallocated HQ overhead, income tax, VAT and additional statutory obligations.
